scope: All 230 Rust-port source identities only; original acceptance and conditional/deferred gates retained. Narrow external owner readiness is retained, not the entire challenge/product backlog.
counting_note: Task and completion-gate counts are not estimates of coding effort. Completed records are provenance, not redispatch.

lanes.title: Exact values and shared values assembly
lanes.responsibility: Exact arithmetic, temporal math, owned numeric aggregates, codecs, public carrier parity; one values Cargo/module/binding assembly writer.

lanes.title: Owned input validation
lanes.responsibility: Prepared TS baseline, provenance, ordered plans/profile interpreter, whole-input adapters, state/HTTP/MCP selected consumers; uses R1 arithmetic and shared assembly.

lanes.title: Work transitions and global delivery
lanes.responsibility: Work/state pure decisions, rows/retry/recovery/receipts/linkage, actual runtime/durable joins, and sole global build/bundle/release writer for every lane.

lanes.title: Retained native artifact preparation
lanes.responsibility: Complete local native preparation job, host stage adapter, exact reviewed-byte publication, executable integrity/lifecycle, real CLI and installed-host qualification. Human preparation hold remains.

resolution.rule: After acknowledged runtime release R2 owns the source; R3 performs final tests without writing invoke.ts again.

global_delivery_writer.rule: Other lanes submit exact delivery requests and consume released source/asset hashes; package-local manifests stay with their defining lane.

values_assembly_writer.rule: R2 owns validation semantics in dedicated modules but submits common registration/bootstrap/selector/export/build requests to R1. One shared arithmetic-validation core.

acceptance_authority: Lane gate owners assemble evidence; the originating independent reviewer/coordinator verifies claims. Gate ownership is not self-acceptance or authorization to overwrite a held scope.
limitations: Every actual future task must reconcile live exact file reservations and current bases.
Static candidates are not startup authority. All runtime instances remain stopped.
R4 preparation and held ports:C04.native-release require human release. Other disjoint R3 delivery tasks are not held by preparation.
Required joins to matching producer/authority/compiler metadata remain exact readiness handoffs; no broader unrelated implementation is authorized.
Whole-call parity, installed/binary integrity, resources, adoption and rollback remain required gates; scalar Rust defaults remain conditional.
